entries.scopeLabel: General distance-k guarantee; ratio independent of g
entries.setting: Unweighted distance-k dominating set on graphs of Euler genus at most g; fixed integer k ≥ 1 and genus bound g ≥ 0; deterministic LOCAL with distinct identifiers, unrestricted messages and local computation; approximation k^{O(k)}, independent of g, in f(g,k) rounds independent of n. No girth restriction.
entries.reason: The paragraph following Theorem X.2.5 explicitly extends the planar algorithm using Meta-Theorem I and Proposition III.7.6. Its approximation ratio depends only on the distance parameter, while its round complexity may depend on both distance and genus. Faster planar and high-girth results require smaller graph classes; schemes with log-star or logarithmic dependence on n do not dominate this round complexity independent of n. This certifies the general distance-k tradeoff, without claiming the best coefficient at every special value of k, tightness or optimal parameter dependence.
